title: Basic Drill: Introductory Indoor Tactical Experience Orlando
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover one of Orlando’s most unique indoor attractions at Decision Tactical, the first-ever tactical theme park where families and friends train, compete, and make split-second decisions in lifelike missions. The Basic Drill is your introduction to the action—choose from two themed tracks packed with immersive scenarios like competition courses, home invasion, diner, and mall encounters. Instructor-guided and fully safe, this hands-on experience teaches teamwork, awareness, and precision while delivering non-stop excitement for all skill levels.

This indoor experience combines the excitement of escape games, the energy of laser tag, and the challenge of an obstacle course—all in one tactical theme park.
